invariants: each record payload matches exactly the contract selected by record.kind
integer payload values are nonnegative safe integers unless the selected field explicitly allows signed values
error-code and error-category values exist in error-codes.json and correspond
every error payload code, category, and operation matches one exact tuple in error-codes.json
input content remains redacted unless trace.redaction.fullContent is true
record.sequence values are unique and strictly increasing as unsigned 64-bit integers

record correlation.recordId values are unique; correlation.contextId always equals rootCorrelation.contextId; when records is nonempty rootCorrelation.initialSequence and initialRecordId equal the first retained record, and when records is empty they identify the next root sequence and record identity
record.timestampNanos values are nondecreasing in record order

each record owns correlation.recordId plus the kind-required domain identity: eventId for Event, commandId for Command, effectSpanId for Effect span, transactionId for transaction or mutation, componentId for reconcile/layout/text, and renderRequestId for render/diff/terminal write

correlation.parentRecordId is the only backward causal reference; when present it resolves to an earlier retained record, while a root record omits it; domain identities label the current record and are not interpreted as parent references
wrapCount greater than zero permits missing predecessors only before the first retained sequence and requires one unattributed boundary record

redaction.fullContent true requires input, clipboard, and terminalPayloads plus replay.applicationInput to equal included/available; fullContent false requires them to equal redacted and forbids encoded fields

replay.runtime available additionally requires fullContent, capture.startedAt context-initialization, capture.completePrefix true, wrapCount zero, and an unbroken record prefix whose first record is context/initialized with ABI 2.0; every other trace declares runtime redacted and completePrefix false

encoded replay fields decode from canonical base64 into exact ABI 2.0 Event batches or complete transaction batches and pass the same validators used by live input; mutation records are diagnostic metadata only and runtime replay applies their value-bearing transaction exactly once

a replay-capable Trace requires encodedEventBatchBase64 on every input record and encodedTransactionBase64 on every committed transaction record, forbids encoded bytes on rejected transactions, and verifies decoded byte counts against payload metadata
committed transaction records forbid failedCommandIndex; rejected records forbid encodedTransactionBase64 and use failedCommandIndex only when rejection identifies one decoded command
every embedded snapshot passes validateDiagnosticSnapshotRuns and each embedded Issue interval is ordered and contained in the Trace's retained sequence domain
runtime replay rejects a record kind whose registered payload contract or migration is unavailable, a trace without a reachable empty-context starting state, or any missing sequence
